**Intent:** Sends a batch of index, update, and delete operations to Elasticsearch in a single HTTP request, reducing per-operation network overhead and reporting per-item errors without failing the whole batch.

**Design decision:** BulkAsync combines heterogeneous write operations into one request body, eliminating per-document HTTP overhead. The Errors property signals any partial failure without throwing, allowing the caller to inspect ItemsWithErrors and retry or log only the failed items while treating successful ones as committed.

**Edge case:** BulkAsync does not guarantee ordering of operations within the batch when the same document appears in multiple operations; Elasticsearch processes them in the order received per shard, but cross-shard ordering is not guaranteed.
